notes:
A redesigned series and anime page for TV.

Seasons now sit in a permanent column on the left with that season's episodes beside them, so every season is one press away instead of hidden behind a dropdown. Episodes are large cards showing the still, number, title, runtime, air date, description and your own watch progress.

The artwork, title, description and buttons stay fixed at the top. Only the season and episode lists scroll, so you never lose sight of what you are browsing, and the remote moves down the list a row at a time instead of jumping.

Choosing an episode now opens a dedicated Streams panel for that episode, showing the full stream detail Reelm already shows on the desktop app: the release name, the addon's star rating, resolution, codec, audio, size, seeders and the addon's own description. Left and Right move between sources, Back returns you to the episode you came from. Movies open the same panel from Play.

Opening a series from My List or the Calendar now lands on this same page. It used to show an older, different screen depending on where you clicked.
